# rixl_image_stats (Data Source)

Fetches viewing metrics, bandwidth consumed, and request count for an image.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image_id` (String)

### Optional

- `rangeend` (String) The range.end query parameter.
- `rangestart` (String) The range.start query parameter.

### Read-Only

- `avg_view_duration_ms` (Number) Dwell time; images have no playback.
- `feed_views` (String)
- `standalone_views` (String)
- `total_view_duration_ms` (Number)
- `total_views` (String)
- `unique_viewers` (String)
